definitions.explanation: Cooked rice pressed by hand into a ball or triangle, often with a filling and wrapped in seaweed; an older, plainer word for おにぎり.

examples.japanese: {握|にぎ}り{飯|めし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{握|にぎ}り{飯|めし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My mother made me rice balls.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山小屋|やまごや}→山小屋：18402_yamagoya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{握|にぎ}り{飯|めし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}まで→今まで：11546_imamade⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧おいしかった。
examples.english: The plain salted rice ball I ate at the mountain hut was the best I've ever had.

notes:
Today most people say ⟦おにぎり→おにぎり：04956_onigiri⟧ or ⟦おむすび→おむすび：10247_omusubi⟧; {握|にぎ}り{飯|めし} sounds old-fashioned and rustic, and appears in stories and historical dramas.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦おにぎり→おにぎり：04956_onigiri⟧: rice ball (the everyday word)
- ⟦おむすび→おむすび：10247_omusubi⟧: rice ball (a softer word, common in some regions)
- ⟦{寿司|すし}→寿司：04946_sushi⟧: sushi; {握|にぎ}り alone often means hand-pressed sushi
